description: Connect ChatGPT to your Nuvemshop store and manage your business using natural language. Search, create, and edit products and categories, check orders, customers, coupons, promotions, shipping methods, and payment options — all from a single conversation. Perfect for store owners who want to run their e-commerce without leaving the chat.
